settings.customCharacterStyle: Use exact canonical older brother and younger brother identities from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter face, skin, hair, outfit, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous sky-island scenes. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One action, one camera move, one speaker maximum. No island reset, no teleporting, no duplicate brothers.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP03 — เกาะลอยฟ้า
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่โลกเกาะลอยฟ้า ข้ามสะพานลมแรง ใช้แพลตฟอร์มเคลื่อนที่ เก็บคริสตัลพลังงานเพื่อเปิดแท่นกระโดด และไปถึงเกาะปลายทางก่อนกลับอย่างปลอดภัย
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous sky-island journey. Preserve exact brother identities and every island/bridge/platform/crystal state between scenes.

scenes.title: เข้าสู่เกาะแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive together on first grassy floating island beside a return portal.
scenes.mainAction: they look across at the next island and narrow rope bridge

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ไปทีละขั้นนะ

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, older taller. Bright floating islands, one narrow bridge ahead, no text/UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use Character Sheets. Wide reveal toward next island. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand at bridge entrance; older left, younger right; portal behind; bridge sways slightly in wind.

scenes.title: ลมแรง
scenes.continuityStartState: Exact Scene 1 end at bridge entrance, wind moving bridge.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother tests first plank with one foot while older braces behind
scenes.imageDescription: Character Sheets + previous scene. Same bridge and positions. Younger tests first plank; older remains behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side shot showing swaying bridge. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger brother stands on first plank holding rope; older brother steps onto bridge directly behind.

scenes.title: ข้ามสะพาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger on first plank, older one step behind, bridge swaying.
scenes.mainAction: both cross slowly keeping same order

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จับเชือกไว้

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and bridge. Younger leads, older follows. Do not swap order or recreate bridge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking across bridge. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach second island; bridge remains behind; moving platform floats ahead across a larger gap.

scenes.title: แพลตฟอร์มเคลื่อนที่
scenes.continuityStartState: Both stand on second island with bridge behind and moving platform cycling ahead.
scenes.mainAction: they watch one platform cycle to learn timing

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มันกลับมาทุกครั้ง

scenes.imageDescription: Same second island and platform cycle. Brothers observe without jumping yet.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static two-shot with platform moving in background. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Platform arrives flush with island edge; younger brother ready first, older beside him.

scenes.title: ขึ้นแพลตฟอร์ม
scenes.continuityStartState: Platform docked at second-island edge; both ready.
scenes.mainAction: both step onto same platform together

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขึ้นพร้อมกัน

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same docked platform; both step aboard, no jump cut.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side follow onto platform. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand centered on moving platform; it begins traveling toward third island; second island recedes behind.

scenes.title: กลางอากาศ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both centered on moving platform traveling toward third island.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother points at glowing crystal on third island

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มีคริสตัลตรงนั้น

scenes.imageDescription: Same moving platform mid-gap. Third island and one glowing crystal visible ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle arc around moving platform. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Platform reaches third-island edge; both face crystal pedestal directly ahead.

scenes.title: เก็บคริสตัลแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Platform docked; brothers face glowing crystal pedestal on third island.
scenes.mainAction: older brother picks up one crystal from pedestal

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เอาอันนี้ไปด้วย

scenes.imageDescription: Same island and pedestal. Older brother picks crystal; younger watches. Crystal disappears from pedestal only after pickup.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium handoff-style shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older brother carries crystal in left hand; pedestal now empty; stone path leads to wind-fan obstacle.

scenes.title: ลมจากใบพัด
scenes.continuityStartState: Older brother carries crystal; both at start of fan path.
scenes.mainAction: both crouch behind low block while fan gust passes

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: รอลมหยุดก่อน

scenes.imageDescription: Preserve crystal in older brother hand. Same brothers hide behind one low block while fan gusts across path.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low three-quarter shot with visible wind effect. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Fan pauses; both stand from cover; older still carrying crystal; clear path to next island connector.

scenes.title: ผ่านทางลม
scenes.continuityStartState: Fan paused; both standing behind low block; older holds crystal.
scenes.mainAction: they run together to far safe zone before fan restarts

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ตอนนี้ ไป

scenes.imageDescription: Same path and fan state. Older keeps crystal; younger stays close. No teleport.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking run. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both arrive at far safe zone; fan restarts behind; energy socket and launch pad visible ahead.

scenes.title: ใส่คริสตัล
scenes.continuityStartState: Both at far safe zone; older holds crystal; energy socket ahead.
scenes.mainAction: older brother inserts crystal into socket

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ลองใส่ตรงนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same crystal transfers from older hand into socket; launch pad off at scene start.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close insert action then glow spreads to pad. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Crystal locked in socket; older hand empty; launch pad glows active; both face it.

scenes.title: แท่นกระโดด
scenes.continuityStartState: Launch pad active from Scene 10; crystal remains in socket.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother steps onto pad first and is gently launched to next island

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ผมไปก่อนนะ

scenes.imageDescription: Same active pad and socket. Younger brother launches first; older remains beside pad.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side angle showing start and landing. Only younger brother speaks before launch.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger brother lands safely on fourth island; older brother still on launch island ready to follow; pad remains active.

scenes.title: พี่ตามมา
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger stands on fourth island; older stands on active launch pad island.
scenes.mainAction: older brother uses same pad and lands beside younger
scenes.imageDescription: Keep same island separation and active pad. Older launches and lands next to younger, no duplicate.
scenes.videoPrompt: Three-quarter follow of older brother flight. Only older brother speaks after landing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both together on fourth island; launch island behind; stepping stones lead to final summit.

scenes.title: หินลอย
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on fourth island; floating stepping stones directly ahead.
scenes.mainAction: they cross first two stones one at a time, younger first

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ตามจังหวะผม

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and stone layout. Younger first, older follows. Completed stones remain behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side follow across two stones. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand on second-to-last large stone; final island edge one jump ahead.

scenes.title: ถึงเกาะยอด
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on second-to-last stone; final island one jump ahead.
scenes.mainAction: older brother jumps first, then younger joins him
scenes.imageDescription: Preserve stepping stones and positions. One clean final jump each, older first.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide side reveal of landing on final island. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand together on final island beside glowing return portal; completed stepping stones visible behind.

scenes.title: มองย้อนกลับ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both beside return portal on final island; completed route behind.
scenes.mainAction: they look back over islands they crossed

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เราไปไกลมากเลย

scenes.imageDescription: Same final island. Brothers foreground, route visible behind in correct order; no reset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow arc from brothers to completed islands. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers turn back toward return portal, standing side-by-side ready to enter.

scenes.title: กลับจากฟ้า
scenes.continuityStartState: Both side-by-side facing return portal on final island.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: กลับกันเถอะ

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and portal. They enter together, final island behind, no extra characters.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; episode complete with route state preserved.
